note: The player's pure reducer (player/queue-state.js), one reduce(state, event) -> [state, effects] case per distinct transition queue-state.test.js asserts, plus itemBounds, the one definition of a bounded item. States, events and item refs are the reducer's own plain objects, written out in full: {type, ...} with items as {id, kind, bounds}. A test that asserts a chain of reductions is split into one case per step, each step's input being the previous step's recorded output (its note says so). Telemetry messages are recorded verbatim: NE-07s ports them byte-identical. Two tests are excluded as js-module-shape (exclusions.json): input immutability and the unknown-event default, neither of which a Swift enum reducer can express.
